name: Guitar controller
definition: Guitar-shaped controller with fret buttons and a strum bar, made to play rhythm games (Guitar Hero, Rock Band type).
notes: Shops list guitars and drum kits as separate products; split from rhythm instrument controller.

name: Drum kit controller
definition: Drum-pad kit with pedal, made to play rhythm games (Rock Band, Guitar Hero World Tour type).
notes: Sold as its own set with pedal, stand and sticks.

name: Repair toolkit
definition: Screwdriver and pry-tool set sold for opening and repairing game consoles and controllers.
notes: Sold as a kit apart from replacement parts.
